title: Onyinyo dị n'azụ ocheeze ahụ
intro: I guzo n'ime ogige nke alaeze ochie dị ike, ebe onye ọchịchị dị ike akpọọla onwe ya dị ka chi n'elu mmadụ niile. N'akụkụ onye ọchịchị a ka otu ohu raara onwe ya nye, onye e nyere ikike ibuli elu nke alaeze ahụ. Ha niile na-akpa nkata ma na-eme atụmatụ, na-ajụ ịṅa ntị n'ịdọ aka ná ntị nke onye ozi e zigara iduzi ha. Ị̀ pụrụ ịchọpụta onye ohu a kwesịrị ntụkwasị obi bụ?
clues: Ebi m n'alaeze dị ike nke otu onye dị ike nke na-ekwu na ọ bụ chi karịa mmadụ niile na-achị.
Ejere m ozi dị ka onye ozi a tụkwasịrị obi nke onye ọchịchị a, na-emezu ihe niile ha chọrọ ime na iwu ha.
Mgbe onye ozi Allah bịara n'ala anyị na-akpọ anyị ka anyị bịa n'eziokwu, mụ na onye ọchịchị m jụrụ ige ntị.
E nyere m iwu ka m gbaa nnukwu ọkụ ma kwadebe brik ụrọ maka nnukwu ihe owuwu.
Onye ọchịchị m chọrọ iwuli ụlọ dị elu nke ga-eru eluigwe.
N'ikpeazụ, onye na-achị m, ndị agha anyị, na mụ onwe m, e wee wụfuo ha n'ime mmiri dị omimi nke oké osimiri.

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
